value.rationale: Variance is the scale parameter in Gaussian and Edgeworth approximations to digit-sum correlation measures. At the same fixed Hamming weight used in recent extremal bias studies, the proven order-one isolation gap and full equality classification give a natural and reusable rigidity fact not furnished by previous first-level or block-count bounds. The arbitrary bit-length uniformity is the key mathematical value.
